selection.selection_metric: test_mse_post = authors' compute_mse on the 92 test days (posterior z, one draw per day, fixed RNG seed 0, common to all restarts); lowest wins

pca.claim: Sec. V-B-2: a PCA on the consumption data: 4 components explain more than 80% of the variance
pca.data: power_consump_nmf.feather: 365 daily 48-half-hour profiles per cluster (cluster-mean kWh)
pca.method: PCA = SVD of the column-centred matrix (sklearn PCA cross-check on raw data); 'uncentred' = share of the total sum of squares (no centring)

extra_temperature_pca_48temps_plus_smoot.note: context only; the temperature PCA claim (3 components ~98%) is checked by the conditions task

effects.definition: diff = mean over the 200 samples of (scenario - Normal), per test day and slot, kWh per household per half-hour (same z draws in both scenarios); region stats average the slots of the region; 'pct' is relative to the Normal mean over the same slots and days

effects_all_restarts.definition: per restart: same scenario construction and z draws as cvae_scenario_effects.json; region means in % of the Normal scenario over the same slots; claimed signs from Sec. VII-C

deviations_from_upstream: PyTorch float64 instead of TF2/Keras float64 (same layers, loss, initialiser family, Keras-Adam update rule).
Each restart uses its own seed (seeds 0..49) for the Glorot init and the reparameterisation noise; upstream reuses one glorot_uniform(seed=0) object and unseeded tf.random.normal.

Fresh Adam per restart; upstream shares ONE Adam instance across all restarts and clusters (Keras iteration counter keeps growing -> later restarts start almost without bias correction, first steps ~3.16x larger).
Selection metric evaluated with a fixed RNG (seed 0, common to all restarts); upstream draws are unseeded.
Generation: z drawn with numpy (default_rng([20200801, cluster])), same z for real-condition samples and the three tariff scenarios (common random numbers).
Upstream selection code is not in the repo; selection = lowest compute_mse on the test set as described in the paper (Sec. V-D).
